notes:
Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.24.2
SRGC now runs across a whole View Bundle: drag its grip onto a bundle of files and it plate-solves anything that isn't solved yet, fetches the survey reference, models and corrects, and saves each file back. It also opens without an image, so you can set it up and drag the grip with nothing loaded, and it now ignores 0.0 no-data — the black surround of a mosaic panel is no longer fitted as sky or lifted off zero. Bundle runs show live progress with the current file, the phase it is in and a Cancel button, instead of looking idle until the end; a command that fails no longer opens one dialog per file, and a file that failed is left alone rather than written back unchanged. WCS handling is fixed for PixInsight and XISF frames whose solution is written as CDELT, or CDELT plus CROTA2, with no CD matrix — those could load with the WCS out of register with the pixels, which showed up as a survey reference that looked mirrored or rotated — and the load-time repair no longer replaces a real solution with one guessed from PIXSCALE and POSANGLE. Solve statistics no longer carry over from an earlier solve by a different solver. Certificate failures are fixed, which mainly bit macOS, where the python.org builds ship no usable trust store and every Gaia database download and survey fetch failed with CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED; downloads are now also checked for completeness before they are kept. Smooth zoom final redraw works again at every zoom level. See the release notes for the full list.
